name: client-rebrand-5-brand
description: Stage 5 of a client rebrand. Codex Astra renders the approved direction in the approved palette as finished PNG artwork — the primary mark, a dimensional treatment, a size ladder and the ground variants — and a critic on a different family judges the picture that exists rather than the brief it came from. PNG only, by operator instruction. Stops at a human gate.

client_dir.description: Absolute path to the case file. 03-direction/ (the approved direction) and 04-theme/tokens.json are what this stage renders from.

conductor.description: Ordered provider chain for the conductor

critic.description: Ordered provider chain for the critic — a different family from the illustrator, which is what makes the second look worth having

sizes.description: The size ladder, in pixels, rendered from the primary mark

max_rounds.description: Maximum critic-and-revise rounds after the first render

agents.instructions: The case file is {{inputs.client_dir}}. Read {{inputs.client_dir}}/state.json before you brief anyone, and quote the client's current name, the incoming name, and the stated reason for the rename in every brief you send — a rebrand brief that names only one of the two names is not a brief. This stage renders the direction the operator approved in 03-direction/, in the colours approved in 04-theme/tokens.json. If a file this stage needs is absent, refuse and name the stage that owes it, exactly as the bytedesk-designer-* skills do; do not reconstruct a missing input from memory or inference. Name the approved concept and quote the exact hex values from tokens.json in the brief — an illustrator that has to guess a colour will guess a nice one. PNG ONLY, by operator instruction: 05-brand/ holds *.png and nothing else. If the illustrator reports an SVG, do not accept it into 05-brand/ and say why. You own the brief and the gate, not the drawing: when paths come back, send the PATHS to the critic and ask for a judgement of the rendered pictures, not of the prompt. Never describe the artwork yourself — you have not seen it. Relay the criticism, run at most {{inputs.max_rounds}} revision rounds, and report the final paths with their sizes in bytes. Write only into {{inputs.client_dir}}/05-brand/ and into this run's artifacts/ directory — no other folder in the case file, and never state.json: the driver owns it and `rebrand collect` is what records a stage. At the gate write artifacts/GATE-brand.md — what was produced and where, what was rejected and why, what could not be determined, and the decision the operator has to make — then stop. Do not continue past it.

You are given paths to rendered PNGs. Open them and look at them. Judge the pictures that exist, not the brief they came from: does the mark read at a glance; does it survive the bottom of the size ladder, which you check by opening the small files rather than by reasoning about the large one; is it one idea or three competing ones; are the colours the ones tokens.json specifies, sampled rather than eyeballed; does the dimensional treatment add depth or add noise; does the mono version hold when colour is gone.

Name the single most consequential change and say what it would cost. Do not rewrite the brief, do not propose a different direction — the direction was approved two gates ago — and do not ask for an SVG: this stage is PNG only by operator instruction.

stages.description: Conductor names the approved concept, quotes the exact token hex values, and states the PNG-only rule.
Astra renders the primary mark, the dimensional treatment, the size ladder rendered at size, and the ground variants, all PNG.
Critic opens the files and judges the pictures, including the small end of the ladder.
Astra regenerates toward the named criticism into new numbered filenames; the critic re-looks.

gates.description: Approve the artwork. Stage 6 puts these renderings on pages, so a mark changed after this gate invalidates every mockup.

artifacts.promote_to: Nothing is promoted out of the case file here, and nothing is published. `rebrand collect brand` records 05-brand/*.png against the approval digest; keep every superseded round under artifacts/ so the operator can see what the criticism actually bought. This spec runs the illustrator with auto_approve, so `ao-topology launch` needs --allow-auto-approve.
